name: Personal data must be collected for a specified and explicit purpose
Processing must not exceed the purpose for which data was collected
Lawful basis must be established prior to processing
Consent must be explicit informed and documented
Consent must be freely given without coercion
Withdrawal of consent must be as easy as giving it
Controller must provide privacy notice at point of collection
Privacy notice must include identity of controller
Privacy notice must state purposes of processing
Privacy notice must include data subject rights
Privacy notice must disclose cross-border transfer intent
Only data necessary for the stated purpose may be collected
Data collected must not be excessive relative to purpose
Personal data must be accurate and kept up to date
Data must not be retained beyond the period necessary for its purpose
Retention periods must be defined and documented
Appropriate technical measures must be implemented to protect personal data
Appropriate organisational measures must be implemented to protect personal data
Access to personal data must be restricted to authorised personnel only
Security controls must be reviewed and updated regularly
Controller must notify SDAIA of breach without undue delay
Breach notification to SDAIA must include nature and scope of breach
Affected data subjects must be notified where breach poses high risk
Breach records must be maintained internally
Data subject has the right to request access to their personal data
Controller must respond to access requests within the regulatory timeframe
Access must be provided free of charge in standard cases
Data subject may request correction of inaccurate personal data
Controller must action correction requests without undue delay
Data subject may request erasure of personal data
Erasure must be completed where no lawful basis for retention exists
Cross-border transfer requires an adequacy decision or appropriate safeguards
Transfer to third countries must not undermine PDPL protections
Controller must document the legal basis for every cross-border transfer
Processing of sensitive data is prohibited except under defined exceptions
Explicit consent is required for sensitive data processing
Sensitive data must be subject to enhanced security controls
Biometric data may only be processed where strictly necessary
Health data processing requires documented lawful basis and DPO involvement
